name: cosmo
description: Security review and zero-day discovery tool. Static pre-filter + multi-model LLM review over a diff, dynamic sandbox confirmation, manual fuzzing, trend/compliance tracking, coordinated disclosure, and authorized external-target recon — all behind a two-tier config trust model, a single egress broker, and a fail-closed public-comment gate. Reuses Claude Code auth/session/tool-use; does not fork it.
